description.value:
Duration constant

Any object you can lift is a martial weapon in your hands, using your best weapon proficiency, dealing damage as a weapon of its size and shape with no improvised penalty. Your unarmed attacks count as martial weapons for every purpose, and no effect can leave you unable to make a weapon Strike so long as you have one hand free and are conscious.

cinderfall.incomplete: Claims any lifted object becomes a martial weapon at the caster's best proficiency dealing weapon-shaped damage with no improvised penalty; unarmed attacks count as martial for every purpose; no effect can leave the caster unable to Strike. pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/martial-proficiency.ts:36 confirms MartialProficiency's sameAs field is a fixed WeaponCategory/ArmorCategory string chosen at authoring time, not a dynamic "your own highest" lookup -- it cannot express "proficiency matching whatever category the caster is already best in." The "no effect can leave you unable to Strike" guarantee has no rule-element analog regardless.
